input.summary: Meridian Health System enterprise profile is partially evidenced; operating-model sizing assumptions remain unvalidated and finance-unattested.
covers: System-of-record landscape (Epic, Claims, Pharmacy, CRM, SAS, Tableau, Power BI)
Evidence confidence baseline for all downstream dimensions
sources: MER-V3-EVID-0001 — Meridian Health System enterprise identity record (high confidence)
MER-V3-EVID-0500 — Profile sizing and operating-model planning assumptions (low confidence)

story.meaning: Meridian's enterprise profile is half-evidenced: organizational identity is confirmed, but the operating-model sizing assumptions that underpin every use-case business case are low-confidence and unattested by Finance.
story.observed: Two active profile rows exist — one high-confidence identity record and one low-confidence planning-assumption record. No owners, systems, or use-case linkages are registered. Confidence split is 50/50.
story.matters: Every downstream dimension — lakehouse, AI governance, cost transparency, payment integrity, call center — inherits its scale and scope assumptions from this profile. An unvalidated profile propagates planning risk across all seven use cases and all C-suite investment decisions.
story.supports: Closing the profile evidence gap is the prerequisite gate before any use-case value quantification can be presented to the CFO or Board as decision-grade.

findings: Profile confidence is split 50/50: the organizational identity is high-confidence, but the operating-model sizing assumptions driving all use-case business cases are low-confidence and finance-unattested — creating a planning risk that cascades across all seven use cases.
No owners, systems, or use-case linkages are registered against the profile dimension, meaning accountability for evidence closure is unassigned and no escalation path exists.

AWS and Databricks are recorded as target-state direction only; no certified platform foundation evidence is loaded, so profile-level scale assumptions cannot be validated against an actual infrastructure baseline.

Until Finance attests the operating-model sizing assumptions, no use-case ROI projection — lakehouse, AI/LLM, payment integrity, cost transparency, or call center — can be presented as decision-grade to the CFO or Board.

evidence.name: Enterprise Identity Record
